reason: A web GUI plugin for configuring thinking intensity, reasoning levels, wire formats, and compatibility options for custom OpenAI-compatible models through existing llm-pi-ai settings.

summaries.zh: 为自定义 OpenAI 兼容模型提供思考强度、推理级别及兼容参数的网页设置界面。
summaries.en: Provides a web settings interface for configuring thinking intensity, reasoning levels, and compatibility options for custom OpenAI-compatible models.

capabilities: Adds a web settings panel for configuring provider and model reasoning levels
Writes reasoning configuration to the existing llm-pi-ai user settings
Exposes configured reasoning options in the model selector and applies provider defaults
